headlines.title: A $1 Million Retirement Portfolio Could Generate $25,000 a Year Without Selling Shares
headlines.summary: The day the last paycheck lands, a saver's question flips from how big the pile is to how much cash it sends home. Five blue-chip payers, from a data center boom to a 70-year streak, each carry a risk worth knowing first.

headlines.title: ETFs Are Net Sellers of Chevron (CVX) on Friday
headlines.summary: ETFs sold $24.5 million of Chevron on Friday, with 46 buying and 21 selling.

headlines.title: ExxonMobil Sinks 14% and Chevron 12% in a Month as Trump Says Iran Wants “to Make a Deal”
headlines.summary: Key TakeawaysExxonMobil and Chevron stock fell 14% and 12% in the past month as Brent crude gave back much of its Iran war premium. The drop didn’t come from the companies’ own results: Chevron’s third-quarter earnings nearly tripled to $9.

headlines.title: Chevron vs. Occidental Petroleum: Which Energy Stock Is a Better Buy for 2027?
headlines.summary: Chevron's broad global reach and low debt stand against Occidental's sharper growth profile and cheaper forward earnings multiple, leaving investors to weigh diversification against focus.

headlines.title: Chevron Corp. (CVX): Q3 Earnings Triple on Refining Margin Surge
headlines.summary: Meridian Funds, managed by ArrowMark Partners, released its third-quarter 2026 investor letter for “Meridian Hedged Equity Fund”. The letter can be downloaded here. In the quarter, a modest gain in U.S. equities masked a significant sector rotation and sharply narrowing leadership. The S&P 500 rose 2.30% in the quarter, bringing the year-to-date gain to 12.75%.

description: Chevron Corporation, through its subsidiaries, engages in the integrated energy and chemicals operations. It operates through Upstream and Downstream segments. The Upstream segment engages in the exploration for, development, production, and transportation of crude oil and natural gas; processing, liquefaction, transportation, and regasification of liquefied natural gas; transportation of crude oil through pipelines; transportation, storage, and marketing of natural gas; carbon capture and storage; and operation of a gas-to-liquids plant. The Downstream segment refines crude oil into petroleum products; markets crude oil, refined products, and lubricants; manufactures and markets renewable fuels; transports crude oil and refined products through pipeline, marine vessel, motor equipment, and rail car; and manufactures and markets commodity petrochemicals, plastics for industrial uses, and fuel and lubricant additives. The company operates in North America, South America, Europe, Africa, Asia, and Australia. The company was formerly known as ChevronTexaco Corporation and changed its name to Chevron Corporation in May 2005. Chevron Corporation was founded in 1879 and is headquartered in Houston, Texas.
